newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GETRONICS LOOKING IN EUROPE FOR BUYS.
newsitem.headline: GETRONICS LOOKING IN EUROPE FOR BUYS.

text.p: Dutch electronics firm Getronics NV said on Thursday it was looking primarily in its existing European markets for acquisition opportunities.
President and chief executive Ton Risseeuw said the markets included Scandinavia. "We are very actively looking for acquisitions there," he told Reuters Financial Television.
He also mentioned Britain, France, Germany, Spain and Portugal as markets in which it had existing operations.
He said Getronics was following its customers rather than spreading its activities more internationally for the sake of growth.
Getronics earlier announced a 45 percent rise in net profit in the first half of 1997 to 79 million guilders and forecast more strong profit and sales growth for the rest of the year.
Risseeuw also said the company achieved its strategy of growing by 20 to 30 percent more than its relevant market in the first half of 1997.
He said he expected the market to grow 10 percent over 1997, compared with 19 percent turnover growth for Getronics in the first half.
